name: cheapshark-api-cli
description: A Node.js Command Line Interface (CLI) application (cli.js) that interacts with the CheapShark API and a file system-based database. The application's purpose is to allow a user to search and get the detailed information through the CLI, while utalizing a backend server that interacts with the cheapshark API by providing endpoints and is able to store search history and selection history in a MongoDB Cloud Atlas instance.
author: Final Project Cheapshark API Team
